items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I don't remember. Benny told me he played with me. I thought he meant he played with my band. ... He might have played with my band, but I don't remember it.

ctx.x: Cecil Scott, that's where I met him; that's where I met Cecil.
How about Benny Waters, was he in the band?
I don't remember. Benny told me he played with me. I thought he meant he played with my band.
